original_description: Use when the user says "file a ticket", "draft an issue", "open an issue for X", "new ticket", asks to refine or audit an existing GitHub issue, or wants a sanity-check on an agent-filed ticket. Applies to all repos.
best_description: Use when the user says "file a ticket", "draft an issue", "open an issue for X", "new ticket", asks to refine or audit an existing GitHub issue, or wants a sanity-check on an agent-filed ticket. Applies to all repos.
final_description: Use this skill whenever the user wants a single GitHub issue written, filed, or improved, in any phrasing. This includes "file a ticket", "draft an issue", or "create an issue for X". It also includes turning a bug report, reproduction steps, a feature idea, a proposal, or session notes into an issue, with or without labels such as bug or feature. Use it to refine, rewrite, groom, audit, or sanity-check an existing issue, including issues that an agent filed. It applies in every repo and package. Do not use it to list, search, or summarize existing issues. Do not use it for PR review, commits, eval runs, or multi-ticket adversarial planning; /ticket-plan does that planning.
